edits.new: Resolve that starting variation in the answer. If it fails, continue testing other requirements; a final counterexample may violate a different condition.
edits.old: Test that exclusion in the answer rather than replacing the question with a different condition.

edits.new: Record exactly one counterexample question per direction: "Which information admitted by [child] falls outside [parent], starting by testing '[one quoted condition]' in [parent alternative]?" Name both nodes. Construct and resolve a concrete starting variation while preserving every child requirement. If that variation is inadmissible or covered, continue testing other parent conditions and permitted topic connections. A counterexample must satisfy the whole child meaning and escape every parent alternative and permitted topic connection; it need not violate the starting condition. Otherwise, establish that every case in every child alternative satisfies all requirements of at least one covering parent alternative or permitted topic connection. Use null if admission, exclusion or necessary coverage remains unresolved. A failed starting variation alone does not establish full coverage.
edits.old: Record one open-ended counterexample question per direction: "Which case admitted by [child] falls outside [parent] while failing [one quoted condition] of [parent alternative]?" Name both nodes and specify the alternative being tested. A condition of one alternative need not constrain another. Construct a concrete candidate satisfying the whole child meaning, preserving every child requirement. Check the selected condition and exclusion from every other parent alternative and permitted topic connection. Give a counterexample only if none covers it. Otherwise, explain the candidate's failure and establish the remaining coverage, or use null if admission or exclusion remains unresolved. A failed candidate alone does not prove full coverage.
